SELECT XXX.* FROM ( SELECT YYY.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTNUM , ROWNUM RN FROM ( /* selectMasterMdCpAgentContactList */ SELECT U.USER_ID AS RECV_PK, -- 유저 ID를 PK값으로 지정 C.COM_CODE AS COM_CODE, C.COM_NAME_LOC AS AGENT_NAME, C.IRS_NO AS AGENT_IRS_NO, C.CEO_NAME_LOC AS AGENT_CEO_NAME, C.TEL_NO AS AGENT_TEL, C.ADDRESS_LOC AS AGENT_ADDRESS, '이력' AS AGNET_HISOTRY FROM ICOMLUSR U, ICOMCMPY C WHERE 1=1 AND U.COM_CODE = C.COM_CODE AND U.USER_TYPE = 'A' -- 관리자 AND C.BUSINESS_COND = 'S' -- 협력사
AND C.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_com_name}||'%'
AND C.IRS_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_irs_no}||'%'
AND C.CEO_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_ceo_name}||'%'
AND C.TEL_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_tel_no}||'%'
AND C.ADDRESS_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_address_loc}||'%'
) YYY ) XXX WHERE XXX.RN BETWEEN #{STARTROW} AND #{ENDROW}

SELECT XXX.* FROM ( SELECT YYY.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTNUM , ROWNUM RN FROM ( /* selectMasterMdCpAgentDmHistoryList */ SELECT DSH.DM_ID, MAX(DSH.RECV_COM_CODE) AS RECV_COM_CODE, MAX(C.COM_NAME_LOC) AS RECV_COM_NAME, MAX(TO_CHAR(DSH.SEND_PROC_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD')) AS SEND_PROC_DATE, DECODE(DSH.SEND_TYPE, 'M', 'E-MAIL', '문자') AS SEND_TYPE, DSH.SEND_TYPE AS DM_TYPE, DECODE(DSH.SEND_TYPE, 'M', (SELECT MAIL_SUBJECT FROM KEP.DM_SEND_SETM WHERE MAILFORM_ID = DSH.MAILFORM_ID), MAX(DSH.SMS_CONTENTS)) AS RECV_SUBJECT, (SELECT MAX(SENT_PO_NO) FROM DM_SEND_INFO WHERE DM_ID = DSH.DM_ID)||DECODE((SELECT count(*) FROM DM_SEND_INFO WHERE DM_ID = DSH.DM_ID), 1,'', ' 외') AS SENT_PO_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(SENT_BUYER) FROM DM_SEND_INFO WHERE SENT_PO_NO = (SELECT MAX(SENT_PO_NO) FROM DM_SEND_INFO WHERE DM_ID = DSH.DM_ID))) AS SENT_BUYER_NAME, MAX(DSH.SMS_CONTENTS) AS SMS_CONTENTS FROM DM_SEND_HIST DSH, ICOMCMPY C, ICOMLUSR U WHERE DSH.RECV_COM_CODE = C.COM_CODE AND DSH.SEND_USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND DSH.SEND_EMAIL != DSH.RECV_ADDRESS -- 운영담당자 본인에게 보낸 메일 이력은 제외
AND C.COM_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_agent_name}||'%'
AND DSH.RECV_ADDRESS LIKE '%'||#{st_agent_tel}||'%'
AND U.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%'||#{st_sender_name}||'%'
AND U.USER_ID = #{st_user_id}
AND DSH.SEND_TYPE IN
'${item}'
GROUP BY DSH.DM_ID, DSH.SEND_TYPE, DSH.MAILFORM_ID ORDER BY MAX(DSH.ADD_DATE) DESC ) YYY ) XXX
WHERE XXX.RN BETWEEN #{STARTROW} AND #{ENDROW}

/* selectMasterMdCpAgentContactHistoryiList */ SELECT COM_CODE, SEQ, DECODE(CH_STATUS, 'D', '삭제', DECODE(CH_STATUS, 'C', NVL(RE_STATUS, '생성'), DECODE(CH_STATUS, 'R', '수정', ''))) AS STATUS, NVL(RE_EMAIL, '') AS RE_EMAIL, NVL(CH_EMAIL, '') AS CH_EMAIL, NVL(RE_MOBILE, '') AS RE_MOBILE, NVL(CH_MOBILE, '') AS CH_MOBILE, NVL(RE_NAME, '') AS RE_NAME, NVL(CH_NAME, '') AS CH_NAME, NVL(RE_REMARK, '') AS RE_REMARK, NVL(CH_REMARK, '') AS CH_REMARK, NVL(RE_RECV_YN, '') AS RE_RECV_YN, NVL(CH_RECV_YN, '') AS CH_RECV_YN, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = CHANGE_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER_NAME, TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS CHANGE_DATE FROM DM_CONTRACT_HIST WHERE COM_CODE = #{st_com_code} AND CH_STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY SEQ DESC

/* selectMasterMdCpAgentDmHistoryContactList */ SELECT C.COM_NAME_LOC AS RECV_COM_NAME, DSH.RECV_NAME AS RECV_USER_NAME, DSH.RECV_ADDRESS AS RECV_CONTACT FROM DM_SEND_HIST DSH, ICOMCMPY C WHERE DSH.RECV_COM_CODE = C.COM_CODE AND DSH.DM_ID = #{DM_ID} AND DSH.SEND_TYPE = #{DM_TYPE}
